newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka says July average inflation at 13.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka says July average inflation at 13.9 pct.

text.p: Sri Lanka's annual average inflation rate fell to 13.9 percent in July from 14.7 percent in June, the Census and Statistics Department said on Friday.
The Colombo Consumers' Price Index (CCPI) for July rose 44.2 points to 2,102.2 from 2,058 in June, the department said in a statement.
It said the rise in the CCPI was mostly due to an increase in the prices of dried chillies, coconut oil, most varieties of dried fish, coconuts, and eggs among other items.
However, prices of garlic, lime and red onions fell during the month, the statement added.
